verses.text: Now one man dey sick, Lazarus, from Bethany, di village of Mary and im sister Martha.
Na that Mary be di one wey anoint Lord with ointment, and wipe im feet with im hair, wey im brother Lazarus dey sick.
So di sisters send word to am say, “Lord, look, di one wey you love well well dey sick.”
But when Jesus hear am, e talk say, “This sickness no be to death, but na for God glory, so that dem go give God Pikin glory through am.”
Now Jesus love Martha, and im sister, and Lazarus.
So when e hear say e dey sick, e stay two days for di place wia e dey.
Den after this e talk to di disciples say, “Make we go Judea again.”
Di disciples talk to am say, “Rabbi, di Jews just dey try stone you, and you dey go there again?”
Jesus answer, “No be say 12 hours of daylight dey? If man waka for day, e no dey stumble, because e dey see di light of this world.
But if man waka for night, e dey stumble, because di light no dey inside am.”
E talk these things, and after that, e talk to dem say, “Our friend, Lazarus, don sleep, but I dey go so that I go wake am from sleep.”
So di disciples talk say, “Lord, if e don sleep, e go recover.”
Now Jesus don talk about im death, but dem think say e dey talk about rest for sleep.
So Jesus talk to dem plainly then, “Lazarus don die.
I glad for una sake say I no dey there, so that una go believe. But make we go to am.”
So Thomas, wey dem dey call Didymus, talk to im fellow disciples say, “Make we go too, so that we go die with am.”
So when Jesus reach, e find say e don dey inside di tomb four days already.
Now Bethany near Jerusalem, about 15 stadia away.
Plenty of di Jews don come join di women round Martha and Mary, to console dem about dem brother.
Den when Martha hear say Jesus dey come, e go meet am, but Mary stay for di house.
So Martha talk to Jesus say, “Lord, if you dey here, my brother no go don die.
Even now I know say anything wey you ask from God, God go give you.”
Jesus talk to am say, “Your brother go rise again.”
Martha talk to am say, “I know say e go rise again for di resurrection for di last day.”
Jesus talk to am say, “I be di resurrection and di life. Di one wey believe me go still live, even if e die.
Everybody wey dey live and believe me no go ever die. You believe this?”
E talk to am say, “Yes, Lord. I don believe say you na di Christ, God Pikin, di one wey dey come enter di world.”
When e don talk this, e go call Mary, im sister, for secret, dey talk say, “Di Teacher dey here and e dey call you.”
When e hear this, e get up quick go meet am.
Now Jesus never enter di village, but e dey di place wia Martha meet am.
Den di Jews wey dey with am for di house, dey console am, when dem see Mary, say e get up quick go out, dem follow am, dey talk say, “E dey go di tomb to cry there.”
So when Mary reach wia Jesus dey and see am, e fall down for im feet, dey talk to am say, “Lord, if you dey here, my brother no go don die.”
When Jesus see am dey cry, and di Jews wey come with am dey cry, e groan for spirit, and e trouble,
and talk say, “Wia una put am?” Dem talk to am say, “Lord, come see.”
Jesus cry.
So di Jews talk say, “Look how e love am!”
Some of dem talk say, “This man wey open di eyes of di blind man no fit make this man no die?”
So Jesus again dey groan for imself, come di tomb. Now e be cave, and stone dey against am.
Jesus talk say, “Remove di stone.” Martha, sister of di dead man, talk to am say, “Lord, by now e don smell, because e don die four days.”
Jesus talk to am say, “I no tell you say if you believe, you go see God glory?”
So dem remove di stone from di place wia di dead man dey lie. Jesus lift up im eyes, talk say, “Papa God, I thank you say you listen to me.
I know say you always dey listen to me, but because of di crowd wey dey stand round I talk this, so that dem go believe say you send me.”
When e don talk this, e shout with loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
Di one wey die come out, dem tie im hand and foot with wrappings, and dem wrap im face with cloth. Jesus talk to dem say, “Free am, let am go.”
So plenty of di Jews wey come to Mary and see wetin Jesus do believe am.
But some of dem go meet di Pharisees tell dem di things wey Jesus do.
So di chief priests and di Pharisees gather council, talk say, “Wetin we dey do? Because this man dey do plenty signs.
If we leave am so, everybody go believe am, and di Romans go come take away both our place and our nation.”
But one of dem, Caiaphas, wey be high priest that year, talk to dem say, “Una no know anything at all,
and una no consider say e better for us say one man die for di people, make di whole nation no perish.”
Now e no talk this by imself, but as e be high priest that year, e prophesy say Jesus go die for di nation,
and no be for di nation only, but so that e go gather together into one di pikin dem of God wey scatter.
So from that day dem plan how dem go kill am.
So Jesus no waka openly among di Jews again, but leave from there go di country near di wilderness, to one town wey dem call Ephraim. E stay there with im disciples.
Now di Passover of di Jews don near, and plenty go up to Jerusalem from di country before di Passover, to purify demself.
Den dem dey look for Jesus, and dey talk to each other, as dem stand for di temple, “Wetin una think? E no go come to di feast at all?”
Now di chief priests and di Pharisees don give commandment say if anybody know wia e dey, make e report am, so that dem go catch am.
Den Jesus, six days before di Passover, come Bethany, wia Lazarus dey, di one wey die, wey e raise from di dead.
So dem make supper for am there. Martha dey serve, but Lazarus na one of di people wey dey sit for table with am.
Mary take one pound of ointment of pure nard, wey cost well well, anoint Jesus feet, and wipe im feet with im hair. Di house full with di fragrance of di ointment.
Den Judas Iscariot, Simon son, one of im disciples, wey go betray am, talk say,
“Why dem no sell this ointment for 300 denarii, give di poor?”
Now e talk this, no be because e care for di poor, but because e be thief, and as e get di purse, e dey steal wetin dem dey put inside.
But Jesus talk say, “Leave am. E don keep this for di day of my burial.
Because una get di poor with una always, but una no get me always.”
Big crowd of di Jews know say e dey there, and dem come, no be for Jesus sake only, but so that dem go see Lazarus too, wey e raise from di dead.
But di chief priests plan to kill Lazarus too,
because of am plenty of di Jews dey leave dem side and believe Jesus.
Di next day, big crowd wey come to di feast, when dem hear say Jesus dey come Jerusalem,
dem take branches of palm trees, go out to meet am, shout, “Hosanna! Blessed be di one wey dey come for di name of di Lord, di King of Israel!”
Jesus find young donkey, sit on am. As e dey write,
“No fear, daughter of Zion. Look, your King dey come, dey sit on donkey colt.”
Im disciples no understand these things first, but when Jesus receive im glory, den dem remember say dem write these things about am, and say dem do these things to am.
So di crowd wey dey with am when e call Lazarus out of di tomb, raise am from di dead, dey testify about am.
For this reason di crowd go meet am too, because dem hear say e do this sign.
So di Pharisees talk among demself, “Look how una no gain anything. Look, di world don follow am.”
Now some Greeks dey among di people wey go up to worship for di feast.
So these ones come to Philip, wey be from Bethsaida of Galilee, ask am, “Oga, we want see Jesus.”
Philip come tell Andrew, and Andrew come with Philip, and dem tell Jesus.
Jesus answer dem, “Di time don reach say dem go give di Son of Man glory.
Na true I dey tell una, unless grain of wheat fall enter di earth and die, e remain alone by imself. But if e die, e bear plenty fruit.
Di one wey love im life go lose am. Di one wey hate im life for this world go keep am to life wey no dey end.
If anybody serve me, make e follow me. Wia I dey, na there my servant go dey too. If anybody serve me, Papa God go honor am.
Now my soul dey trouble. Wetin I go talk? ‘Papa God, save me from this hour?’ But na for this reason I come to this hour.
Papa God, give your name glory!” Den voice come from di sky, dey talk say, “I don give am glory, and I go give am glory again.”
So di crowd wey stand there and hear am talk say thunder dey. Others talk say, “Angel don talk to am.”
Jesus answer, “This voice no come for my sake, but for una sake.
Now na di judgment of this world. Now dem go throw out di prince of this world.
And I, if dem lift me up from di earth, I go draw all people to myself.”
But e talk this, to show wetin kind death e go die.
Di crowd answer am, “We don hear from di law say di Christ dey remain forever. How you take dey talk, ‘Dem must lift up di Son of Man?’ Who be this Son of Man?”
So Jesus talk to dem say, “Small time more di light dey with una. Waka while una get di light, so that darkness no go overtake una. Di one wey dey waka for darkness no know wia e dey go.
While una get di light, believe di light, so that una go become pikin dem of light.” Jesus talk these things, and e leave and hide from dem.
But though e don do so many signs before dem, still dem no believe am,
so that di word of Isaiah di prophet go fulfill, wey e talk, “Lord, who don believe wetin we report? To who dem reveal di arm of di Lord?”
For this reason dem no fit believe, because Isaiah talk again,
“E don blind dem eyes and harden dem heart, so that dem no go see with dem eyes, and perceive with dem heart, and turn, and I go heal dem.”
Isaiah talk these things when e see im glory, and e talk about am.
Still even among di rulers plenty believe am, but because of di Pharisees dem no confess am, so that dem no go put dem out of di synagogue,
because dem love men praise pass God praise.
Jesus shout, talk say, “Di one wey believe me no believe me, but di one wey send me.
Di one wey see me see di one wey send me.
I don come as light enter di world, so that anybody wey believe me no go remain for darkness.
If anybody listen to my words, and no believe, I no dey judge am. Because I no come to judge di world, but to save di world.
Di one wey reject me, and no receive my words, get one wey go judge am. Di word wey I talk, na im go judge am for di last day.
Because I no talk from myself, but Papa God wey send me, na im give me commandment, wetin I must say, and wetin I must talk.
I know say im commandment na life wey no dey end. So di things wey I dey talk, just as Papa God don talk to me, na so I dey talk.”
Now before di feast of di Passover, Jesus, as e know say im hour don reach wey e go leave this world go Papa God, as e don love im own wey dey for di world, e love dem reach di end.
During supper, di devil don already put am for di heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon son, to betray am,
Jesus, as e know say Papa God don put all things inside im hands, and say e come from God, and dey go to God,
get up from supper, put aside im outer clothes. E take towel, tie towel round im waist.
Den e pour water inside basin, begin wash di disciples feet, and wipe dem with di towel wey e tie round imself.
Den e come to Simon Peter. E talk to am say, “Lord, you dey wash my feet?”
Jesus answer am, “You no know wetin I dey do now, but you go understand later.”
Peter talk to am say, “You no go ever wash my feet!” Jesus answer am, “If I no wash you, you no get part with me.”
Simon Peter talk to am say, “Lord, no be my feet only, but my hands and my head too!”
Jesus talk to am say, “Di one wey don bathe only need make dem wash im feet, but e clean completely. Una clean, but no be all of una.”
Because e know di one wey go betray am; so e talk say, “No be all of una clean.”
So when e don wash dem feet, put on im outer clothes, and sit down again, e talk to dem say, “Una know wetin I don do to una?
Una dey call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ Una dey talk am correct, because na so I be.
If I then, Lord and Teacher, don wash una feet, una suppose wash each other feet too.
Because I don give una example, so that una go do as I don do to una too.
Na true I dey tell una, servant no greater pass im oga, and di one wey dem send no greater pass di one wey send am.
If una know these things, blessed be una if una do dem.
I no dey talk about una all. I know who I don choose. But so that di Scripture go fulfill, ‘Di one wey dey chop bread with me don lift up im heel against me.’
From now, I dey tell una before e happen so that when e happen, una go believe say na me.
Na true I dey tell una, di one wey receive anybody wey I send receive me; and di one wey receive me receive di one wey send me.”
When Jesus don talk this, e trouble for spirit, and e testify, “Na true I dey tell una say one of una go betray me.”
Di disciples dey look each other, confuse about who e dey talk about.
One of im disciples, wey Jesus love, dey sit for table, lean for Jesus chest.
Simon Peter wave hand to am, talk to am say, “Tell us who e be wey e dey talk about.”
E lean back, as e dey, for Jesus chest, ask am, “Lord, who be am?”
So Jesus answer, “Na di one wey I go give this piece of bread when I don dip am.” So when e don dip di piece of bread, e give Judas, Simon Iscariot son.
After di piece of bread, Satan enter am. Den Jesus talk to am say, “Wetin you dey do, do am quick.”
Now nobody for di table know why e talk this to am.
Because some think, because Judas get di money box, say Jesus talk to am, “Buy wetin we need for di feast,” or say make e give something to di poor.
So as e don receive that piece, e go out at once. Na night.
When e don go out, Jesus talk say, “Now dem give di Son of Man glory, and dem give God glory inside am;
and God go give am glory inside imself, and e go give am glory at once.
My small pikin dem, I go dey with una small time more. Una go look for me, and as I tell di Jews, ‘Wia I dey go, una no fit come,’ so now I dey tell una.
New commandment I dey give una, say una love each other. Just as I don love una, una love each other too.
By this everybody go know say una be my disciples, if una get love for each other.”
Simon Peter talk to am say, “Lord, wia you dey go?” Jesus answer, “Wia I dey go, you no fit follow now, but you go follow later.”
Peter talk to am say, “Lord, why I no fit follow you now? I go lay down my life for you.”
Jesus answer am, “You go lay down your life for me? Na true I dey tell you, cock no go crow until you don deny me three times.”
“No let your heart trouble. Believe God. Believe me too.
For my Papa God house plenty rooms dey. If e no be so, I go don tell una. I dey go prepare place for una.
If I go and prepare place for una, I go come again and receive una to myself; so that wia I dey, una go dey there too.
Una know wia I dey go, and una know di way.”
Thomas talk to am say, “Lord, we no know wia you dey go. How we go take know di way?”
Jesus talk to am say, “I be di way, di truth, and di life. Nobody dey come to Papa God, except by me.
If una know me, una go know my Papa God too. From now, una know am, and don see am.”
Philip talk to am say, “Lord, show us Papa God, and e don enough for us.”
Jesus talk to am say, “I don dey with una for such long time, and you no know me, Philip? Di one wey see me don see Papa God. How you take dey talk, ‘Show us Papa God?’
You no believe say I dey inside Papa God, and Papa God dey inside me? Di words wey I dey tell una, I no dey talk dem from myself; but Papa God wey dey live inside me dey do im works.
Believe me say I dey inside Papa God, and Papa God dey inside me; if no be so, believe me for di very works sake.
Na true I dey tell una, di one wey believe me, di works wey I dey do, e go do dem too; and e go do greater works pass these, because I dey go to my Papa God.
Anything wey una go ask for my name, na that I go do, so that dem go give Papa God glory inside di Pikin.
If una ask anything for my name, I go do am.”
“If una love me, keep my commandments.
I go pray to Papa God, and e go give una another Counselor, so that e go dey with una forever,
even di Spirit of truth, wey di world no fit receive; because e no see am, and e no know am. Una know am, because e dey live with una, and e go dey inside una.
I no go leave una like orphans. I go come to una.
Small time more, and di world no go see me again; but una go see me. Because I dey live, una go live too.
For that day una go know say I dey inside my Papa God, and una inside me, and I inside una.
Di one wey get my commandments, and dey keep dem, na im be di one wey love me. Di one wey love me, my Papa God go love am, and I go love am, and I go reveal myself to am.”
Judas, di one wey no be Iscariot, talk to am say, “Lord, wetin happen say you wan reveal yourself to us, and no be to di world?”
Jesus answer am, “If man love me, e go keep my word. My Papa God go love am, and we go come to am, and make our home with am.
Di one wey no love me no dey keep my words. Di word wey una dey hear no be mine, but na Papa God own wey send me.”
“I don talk these things to una, while I still dey with una.
But di Counselor, di Holy Spirit, wey Papa God go send for my name, e go teach una all things, and e go remind una all wey I talk to una.
Peace I dey leave with una. My peace I dey give una; no be as di world dey give, I dey give una. No let your heart trouble, and no let am fear.
Una hear how I tell una, ‘I dey go away, and I go come to una.’ If una love me, una go don rejoice, because I talk ‘I dey go to my Papa God;’ because Papa God greater pass me.
Now I don tell una before e happen, so that when e happen, una go believe.
I no go talk plenty with una again, because di prince of di world dey come, and e no get anything inside me.
But so that di world go know say I love Papa God, just as Papa God command me, na so I dey do. Get up, make we leave here.”
“I be di true vine, and my Papa God na di farmer.
Every branch inside me wey no bear fruit, e dey take am away. Every branch wey bear fruit, e dey prune am, so that e go bear more fruit.
Una don clean already because of di word wey I don talk to una.
Remain inside me, and I inside una. As di branch no fit bear fruit by imself, unless e remain inside di vine, na so una no fit too, unless una remain inside me.
I be di vine. Una be di branches. Di one wey remain inside me, and I inside am, na im dey bear plenty fruit, because without me una no fit do anything.
If man no remain inside me, dem go throw am out like branch, and e go dry; and dem dey gather dem, throw dem inside fire, and dem go burn.
If una remain inside me, and my words remain inside una, una go ask anything wey una want, and dem go do am for una.
For this my Papa God get glory, say una bear plenty fruit; so una go be my disciples.
Just as Papa God don love me, I don love una too. Remain for my love.
If una keep my commandments, una go remain for my love; just as I don keep my Papa God commandments, and I remain for im love.
I don talk these things to una, so that my joy go remain inside una, and so that una joy go full.
Na this be my commandment, say una love each other, just as I don love una.
Nobody get greater love pass this, say person lay down im life for im friends.
Una be my friends, if una do anything wey I command una.
I no dey call una servants again, because servant no know wetin im oga dey do. But I don call una friends, because everything wey I hear from my Papa God, I don make am known to una.
Una no choose me, but I choose una, and appoint una, so that una go out and bear fruit, and so that una fruit go remain; so that anything wey una ask from Papa God for my name, e go give una.
I command these things to una, so that una go love each other.
If di world hate una, una know say e hate me before e hate una.
If una be of di world, di world go love im own. But because una no be of di world, but I choose una out of di world, na why di world hate una.
Remember di word wey I talk to una: ‘Servant no greater pass im oga.’ If dem persecute me, dem go persecute una too. If dem keep my word, dem go keep una own too.
But all these things dem go do to una for my name sake, because dem no know di one wey send me.
If I no come and talk to dem, dem no go get sin; but now dem no get excuse for dem sin.
Di one wey hate me, hate my Papa God too.
If I no do among dem di works wey nobody else do, dem no go get sin. But now dem don see and hate both me and my Papa God.
But this happen so that di word go fulfill wey dem write for dem law, ‘Dem hate me without reason.’
When di Counselor don come, wey I go send to una from Papa God, di Spirit of truth, wey dey come from Papa God, e go testify about me.
Una go testify too, because una don dey with me from di beginning.”
“I don talk these things to una, so that una no go stumble.
Dem go put una out of di synagogues. Yes, di time dey come wey anybody wey kill una go think say e dey do service to God.
Dem go do these things because dem no know Papa God, or me.
But I don talk these things to una, so that when di time reach, una go remember say I tell una about dem. I no tell una these things from di beginning, because I dey with una.
But now I dey go to di one wey send me, and none of una dey ask me, ‘Wia you dey go?’
But because I don tell una these things, sorrow don full una heart.
But I dey tell una di truth: E good for una say I go away, because if I no go away, di Counselor no go come to una. But if I go, I go send am to una.
When e don come, e go convict di world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
about sin, because dem no believe me;
about righteousness, because I dey go to my Papa God, and una no go see me again;
about judgment, because dem don judge di prince of this world.
I still get plenty things to tell una, but una no fit bear dem now.
But when e don come, di Spirit of truth, e go guide una enter all truth, because e no go talk from imself; but anything wey e hear, na im e go talk. E go declare to una di things wey dey come.
E go give me glory, because e go take from wetin be mine, and declare am to una.
All things wey Papa God get na mine; so I talk say e dey take from wetin be mine, and e go declare am to una.
Small time, and una no go see me. Again small time, and una go see me.”
So some of im disciples talk to each other say, “Wetin be this wey e dey tell us, ‘Small time, and una no go see me, and again small time, and una go see me;’ and, ‘Because I dey go to Papa God?’”
So dem talk say, “Wetin be this wey e dey talk, ‘Small time?’ We no know wetin e dey talk.”
So Jesus know say dem want ask am, and e talk to dem say, “Una dey ask each other about this, say I talk, ‘Small time, and una no go see me, and again small time, and una go see me?’
Na true I dey tell una, say una go cry and lament, but di world go rejoice. Una go sorrow, but una sorrow go turn to joy.
Woman, when e dey born, e get pain, because im time don reach. But when e don born di pikin, e no remember di anguish again, because of di joy say human being don born for di world.
So una get sorrow now, but I go see una again, and una heart go rejoice, and nobody go take una joy from una.
For that day una no go ask me any question. Na true I dey tell una, anything wey una ask from Papa God for my name, e go give una.
Until now, una never ask anything for my name. Ask, and una go receive, so that una joy go full.
I don talk these things to una with figures of speech. But di time dey come wey I no go talk to una with figures of speech again, but I go tell una plainly about Papa God.
For that day una go ask for my name; and I no dey tell una say I go pray to Papa God for una,
because Papa God imself love una, because una don love me, and don believe say I come from God.
I come out from Papa God, and don come enter di world. Again, I dey leave di world, and go to Papa God.”
Im disciples talk to am say, “Look, now you dey talk plainly, and you no dey use figures of speech.
Now we know say you know all things, and you no need make anybody ask you question. By this we believe say you come from God.”
Jesus answer dem, “Una believe now?
Look, di time dey come, yes, and e don reach, wey una go scatter, each person go im own place, and una go leave me alone. Yet I no dey alone, because Papa God dey with me.
I don tell una these things, so that inside me una go get peace. For di world una get oppression; but take courage! I don overcome di world.”
